description: User-initiated diagnostics bundle builder (V3-#10). Assembles version/platform info, audit summary, task evidence counts, masked config snapshot, error excerpt and perf-baseline summary into a portable JSON + HTML bundle; every free-text field is redacted with the shared @ai-factory/security secret patterns, and a self-check refuses any bundle that still matches a pattern. Server-only package: the desktop talks to it over HTTP, never imports it.
name: @ai-factory/diagpack
